title: FDA Primary Endpoints and Trial Designs in Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension Approvals
summary: FDA precedent on PAH primary endpoints and trial designs: six-minute walk distance, clinical worsening, morbidity/mortality outcomes and hemodynamics across approvals.
body_markdown:
## FDA endpoints in pulmonary arterial hypertension approvals: six-minute walk distance, clinical worsening and hemodynamics


FDA's pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) precedent falls into two broad phases. Most first-generation approvals (bosentan, ambrisentan, sildenafil, tadalafil, riociguat, inhaled and oral treprostinil, epoprostenol) rested on 12- to 16-week, placebo- or standard-therapy-controlled trials with change in six-minute walk distance (6MWD) as the primary endpoint. Since then, the major programs (macitentan, selexipag, the oral treprostinil outcome study, initial ambrisentan plus tadalafil, and the sotatercept supplement) have moved to event-driven trials with time to first morbidity/mortality or clinical-worsening event as the primary endpoint. Throughout, reviewers treated hemodynamics (PVR, cardiac output or index, mean pulmonary artery pressure) as supportive evidence of pharmacologic activity, not a substitute for clinical benefit. The two exceptions are a fixed-dose combination and a pediatric extrapolation program.


### Key takeaways


- **6MWD supports an exercise-capacity claim, not a morbidity or mortality claim.** Reviewers described 6MWD as a measure of exercise capacity, not a stand-in for survival or clinical events[355](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=355)[356](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=356) , and approvals built on it were framed accordingly. For tadalafil, the review called the 40 mg dose effective "for improving exercise tolerance only"[215](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=215) .
- **Walk-distance effects have often been small or contested.** Remodulin's walk-distance effect was a 10 m median difference that did not reach conventional significance[408](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=408)[409](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=409) . GRIPHON's significant 12 m week-26 effect was called of "little or no clinical meaning" by the statistical reviewer[517](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=517) . For sotatercept, reviewers benchmarked the 41 m effect against an estimated 33 m minimal clinically important difference[228](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=228) .
- **Clinical worsening as a secondary endpoint frequently failed or was contested.** Tyvaso[427](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=427) , Revatio[300](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=300) and Adcirca[599](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=599) did not show significant clinical-worsening benefit in their 6MWD-primary trials. For ambrisentan, FDA statisticians and clinicians disagreed on whether the secondary worsening endpoint could support labeling[473](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=473)[474](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=474) .
- **Event-driven composites are now the main route to outcome claims, but none established a standalone mortality benefit.** Macitentan's benefit was "largely driven by worsening-of-PAH events" with no apparent effect on overall mortality[93](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=93)[94](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=94) . Selexipag showed no demonstrated all-cause mortality benefit (HR 0.97)[515](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=515) .
- **6MWD lives on inside the composites.** "Other worsening" or "disease progression" components typically required a confirmed ≥15% 6MWD decline plus a second criterion such as symptoms, functional class or need for new therapy[242](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=242)[516](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=516)[654](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=654) .


### Phase 1: six-minute walk distance as the primary endpoint


The classic PAH design was a short, randomized, double-blind trial with change from baseline in 6MWD at week 12 or 16. Background therapy rules tightened or loosened depending on which PAH drug classes existed at the time.


Product (active) Pivotal trial(s) and design Primary endpoint Primary result


Tracleer (bosentan) BREATHE-1 (n=213, 1:1:1, 16 weeks) and Study 351 (n=32, 2:1, 12 weeks); WHO FC III to IV; add-on to conventional therapy, no epoprostenol[328](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=328)[329](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=329)[330](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=330) 6MWD Placebo-subtracted +35 m (125 mg) and +54 m (250 mg) in BREATHE-1; +76 m in Study 351[331](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=331)[332](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=332)[333](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=333)


Letairis (ambrisentan) ARIES-1 and ARIES-2, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, two doses each; recent PDE5 inhibitor use excluded[64](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=64)[65](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=65)[67](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=67) 6MWD at week 12 Placebo-adjusted +31 to +59 m across doses[68](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=68)[69](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=69)[70](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=70)[71](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=71)


Revatio (sildenafil) Study A1481140, 12 weeks, 1:1:1:1 (placebo or 20, 40, 80 mg TID), n=278, catheter-confirmed PAH, baseline 6MWD 100 to 450 m[498](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=498) 6MWD at week 12 Placebo-corrected +45 to +50 m, all p<0.0001[500](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=500)


Adcirca (tadalafil) H6D-MC-LVGY, 16 weeks, five arms, stratified by etiology, baseline 6MWD and bosentan use[372](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=372)[373](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=373)[374](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=374) 6MWD at week 16 Only 40 mg met the prespecified 0.01 criterion (+26 m; adjusted estimate 32.8 m)[594](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=594)[596](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=596)[597](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=597)


Adempas (riociguat) PATENT-1, 12 weeks, n=443; about 50% treatment-naive, 44% on an ERA background[175](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=175)[177](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=177)[178](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=178) 6MWD at week 12 Placebo-corrected about +36 m (mean about +30 m on riociguat vs about -6 m on placebo), p<0.0001[179](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=179)


Tyvaso (inhaled treprostinil) TRIUMPH I, 12 weeks, n=235, add-on to stable bosentan or sildenafil[456](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=456)[457](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=457) Peak 6MWD at week 12 Median placebo-corrected +20 m[458](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=458)[459](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=459)


Orenitram (oral treprostinil) Study 1, 12 weeks, 2:1, treatment-naive monotherapy, n=349 (primary population 228)[542](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=542)[543](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=543) 6MWD at week 12 Hodges-Lehmann +23 m, p=0.013[544](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=544)


Flolan (epoprostenol) Study 46, open-label, randomized vs conventional therapy, 12 weeks, severe PPH[147](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=147) ; VA1A4001 in scleroderma-spectrum PH, open-label, 12 weeks[149](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=149) 6MWD Adjusted +30 m vs -50 m in Study 46[148](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=148) ; nonparametric p<0.0001 in VA1A4001[150](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=150)


Winrevair (sotatercept) STELLAR, n=323, FC II to III, 96% on double or triple background therapy, 40% on infused prostacyclin[114](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=114) 6MWD at week 24 Placebo-adjusted median +41 m (95% CI 28 to 54)[115](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=115)


Several design features recur in the reviews:


- **Timing of the walk test matters.** For Tyvaso, 6MWD was measured at peak exposure, 10 to 60 minutes after inhalation[458](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=458) . The reviewer reported a trough difference of about 13 m, roughly two-thirds of the peak effect[429](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=429) . For ambrisentan, reviewers qualified the benefit as shown "at least at peak drug levels" and requested a postmarketing study of walking capacity away from peak[468](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=468)[469](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=469) .
- **Blinding is scrutinized.** The riociguat Division stressed blinding when interpreting walk results and called a documented 100 m improvement in an open-label study questionable[275](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=275) . In the open-label Flolan studies, a reviewer accepted the walking-distance finding as replicated despite possible bias from permitted coaching[99](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=99) .
- **Dose selection follows the 6MWD alpha.** Tadalafil's 20 mg dose was described as potentially supportable as a minimum effective dose but did not meet the prespecified criterion[596](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=596) .
- **Trial failures are informative.** Orenitram's add-on Studies 2 and 3 (16-week 6MWD trials on ERA and/or PDE5 inhibitor background) did not show an exercise benefit[547](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=547) . Bosentan's WHO FC II trial used PVR and 6MWD as coprimary endpoints. Hemodynamics improved significantly, but the 19 m 6MWD advantage was not significant (p=0.08)[366](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=366) .


#### Composite and responder variants of 6MWD


Two early programs did not rely on 6MWD alone:


- **Ventavis (iloprost):** ME97218 used a week-12 responder endpoint requiring all three of the following: at least a 10% 6MWD improvement measured 30 minutes post-dose, improvement of at least one NYHA class, and no death or PH deterioration[21](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=21) . Response rates in WHO Group I PAH were 19% vs 4% (p=0.0033)[22](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=22) . The label stated that evidence of benefit was inadequate in the CTEPH subgroup[22](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=22) .
- **Remodulin (subcutaneous treprostinil):** The prespecified 6MWD analysis did not meet its criterion[40](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=40) . Approval rested on a post-hoc composite of walk distance and Borg dyspnea score[410](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=410) . FDA considered it reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit and approved under Subpart H accelerated approval (21 CFR 314.510), with a required postmarketing confirmatory study[622](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=622)[624](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=624) . The indication was limited to diminishing "symptoms associated with exercise"[623](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=623) . FDA later stated that approval of a 2006 efficacy supplement fulfilled those commitments[625](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=625) . Reviewers were openly skeptical: Dr. Temple called the distance difference "very small" and questioned net benefit given infusion-site pain[35](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=35) .


### Phase 2: event-driven morbidity/mortality trials


From macitentan onward, sponsors moved to long, event-driven trials, usually on top of background PAH therapy.


Product Trial and design Primary endpoint Result


Opsumit (macitentan) SERAPHIN, n=742, 1:1:1, event-driven (about 1 to 4.5 years), 64% on background PAH therapy[258](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=258)[259](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=259)[260](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=260) Time to first adjudicated morbidity/mortality event: death, atrial septostomy, lung transplant, IV/SC prostanoid initiation, or other PAH worsening[242](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=242) HR 0.547 for 10 mg (p<0.0001); other PAH worsening was the largest contributor[261](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=261)[262](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=262)


Uptravi (selexipag) GRIPHON, n=1,156, 1:1, up to 70 weeks, about 80% on background ERA and/or PDE5 inhibitor[204](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=204)[205](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=205)[206](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=206) Time to first morbidity/mortality event, including hospitalization, parenteral prostanoid or chronic oxygen, and disease progression[183](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=183) HR 0.61 (99% CI 0.46 to 0.81), driven by hospitalization and progression events[207](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=207)


Orenitram (oral treprostinil) Study 4, n=690, 1:1, event-driven, single background PAH therapy[545](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=545) Time to first clinical-worsening event 26% vs 36%; HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.57 to 0.99)[546](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=546)


Letairis + tadalafil AMBITION, initial combination vs each monotherapy (ITT n=302/152/151)[651](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=651)[652](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=652) Time to first clinical failure: death, PAH hospitalization, or short- or long-term clinical worsening defined by 6MWD decline plus FC III/IV symptoms[654](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=654) Lower risk of clinical failure with the combination than with either monotherapy (hazard ratios of about 0.5); hospitalization showed the clearest advantage; death CIs crossed 1[651](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=651)[655](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=655)


Winrevair (sotatercept), 2026 supplement ZENITH: FC III to IV, high mortality risk, n=172, 72% on triple therapy[553](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=553)[554](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=554) . HYPERION: diagnosed within 12 months, FC II to III, n=320[561](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=561) ZENITH: death, lung transplant, or PAH hospitalization of at least 24 h. HYPERION: death or first confirmed morbidity event[555](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=555)[231](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=231) ZENITH HR 0.24, stopped for efficacy at an interim analysis[555](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=555)[556](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=556)[557](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=557) . HYPERION HR 0.24, stopped early with 76 of 121 planned events[231](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=231)[562](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=562)[563](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=563)


FDA's development advice for selexipag shows how the agency framed the choice. Before GRIPHON, FDA said either a 6MWT effect or a time-to-clinical-worsening effect could support approval. It cautioned that a program showing only a 6MWT effect might need dose-response data, and it accepted a single study with clinical worsening as the primary endpoint. A secondary exercise-capacity claim from that study would need to test 6MWD at the 0.01 level[511](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=511)[512](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=512) . GRIPHON accordingly moved 6MWD to a week-26 secondary endpoint[513](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=513)[514](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=514) .


### How FDA has weighed 6MWD against clinical worsening


#### Clinical worsening as a secondary endpoint behind 6MWD


In the 6MWD-primary era, clinical worsening was typically tested lower in the hierarchy and often failed:


- **Revatio:** After a positive 6MWD result and significant mPAP reductions, the reviewer found no difference in time to clinical worsening, and further secondary testing stopped under the statistical plan[299](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=299)[300](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=300)[301](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=301) . A later add-on-to-epoprostenol study did show both a 26 m 6MWD effect and a significant delay in clinical worsening[302](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=302)[303](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=303) .
- **Tyvaso:** Time to clinical worsening was first in the secondary hierarchy and did not differ (p=0.5829), so no further secondary endpoint could be called significant[427](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=427)[428](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=428) .
- **Adcirca:** Clinical worsening improved numerically (5% at 40 mg vs 16% on placebo) but not significantly[598](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=598)[599](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=599) . A reviewer said secondary endpoints served to support the primary endpoint, "not additional indications"[218](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=218) .
- **Orenitram monotherapy:** Clinical worsening (9% vs 13%) did not corroborate the 6MWD result[415](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=415) . Clinical reviewers recommended against approval in one review cycle after reassessing dropouts and finding the exercise result unreliable[413](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=413)[414](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=414) .
- **Bosentan:** BREATHE-1 worsening through week 28 was 6.3% vs 20.3%, mostly reflecting fewer PAH hospitalizations[359](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=359)[360](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=360)[361](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=361) . Study 351 had only three events, too few for its planned time-to-event analysis[362](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=362) .


The ambrisentan review shows how the two disciplines can split. Clinicians favored a clinical-worsening claim. Statisticians judged that the secondary endpoint did not provide substantial evidence: results differed between trials, the analysis plan changed near study end, and type I error control was inadequate[473](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=473)[474](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=474) . The riociguat Division warned that clinical-worsening endpoints can be affected by unblinding and asked for a prespecified, alpha-conserving analysis[276](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=276)[277](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=277) .


#### 6MWD inside the composite


In outcome trials, 6MWD rarely counts as an event on its own. SERAPHIN's "other worsening" required a confirmed ≥15% 6MWD decline, worsening symptoms, and a need for new PAH treatment, with independent adjudication[242](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=242)[92](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=92) . GRIPHON's disease progression required a confirmed ≥15% decline plus worsening functional class or a need for additional therapy[516](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=516) . AMBITION and HYPERION used similar 6MWD-plus-another-sign constructs[654](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=654)[232](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=232) . As a result, clinical-worsening results are not independent of walking distance. The later Tyvaso clinical-worsening endpoint included a sustained 6MWD decrease of more than 15%[432](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=432) .


This shapes how reviewers read the results. For macitentan, the cross-discipline reviewer noted that the benefit was largely driven by deterioration in 6MWD and the need for new therapy[93](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=93) . The label described the primary benefit as primarily attributable to fewer clinical-worsening events, not as a mortality benefit[95](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=95) .


#### Clinical meaningfulness of the walk-distance effect


Reviews have increasingly separated statistical from clinical significance:


- **Selexipag:** The 12 m week-26 effect (99% CI 1 to 24) occurred while both arms deteriorated. The statistical reviewer called it of "little or no clinical meaning"[517](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=517) . The cross-discipline team leader still considered the small but consistent 6MWD results supportive of the primary endpoint[518](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=518) .
- **Sotatercept:** Reviewers compared the 41 m median difference with an estimated 33 m MCID and concluded the improvement was clinically meaningful[228](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=228) .
- **Tadalafil:** The 33 m effect at 40 mg was characterized as similar to the exercise effects of many other approved PAH treatments[214](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=214) . A reviewer also noted limitations in how the test is measured[213](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=213) .
- **Opsynvi:** A review row cites placebo-corrected 6MWD improvements of about 22 to 36 m across PAH trials as context[501](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=501) .


### Hemodynamic endpoints: supportive, rarely primary


Reviewers have consistently declined to treat PVR, cardiac output or mPAP as surrogates for clinical outcome in adults:


- A bosentan reviewer explained that PVR and cardiac output quantify the disease process and correlate with exercise changes, but had not been shown to predict morbidity or mortality[365](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=365) .
- The riociguat Division said approved PAH products had not established a correlation between exercise and hemodynamic effects, which can appear before an exercise benefit[274](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=274) .
- The Revatio label stated that the relationship between hemodynamic effects and 6MWD improvement was unknown[305](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=305) .
- For sotatercept, PVR (median difference -234.6 dyn·s/cm⁵) was called a hemodynamic biomarker showing pharmacologic activity and supporting the clinical endpoints[234](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=234) . Reviewers also rejected STELLAR's multicomponent responder endpoint for a Clinical Studies labeling claim because its NT-proBNP component was neither a clinical endpoint nor a surrogate[236](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=236) .
- For Flolan, a reviewer said hemodynamic measurements were not efficacy endpoints, even though significant differences were reported[99](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=99) .
- For tadalafil, hemodynamics were described as generally of minor interest and analyzed descriptively[219](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=219)[220](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=220) .


Hemodynamics have served as the primary basis in two settings:


1. **Fixed-dose combination of approved components.** Opsynvi's A DUE trial used PVR at week 16 as the primary endpoint, comparing the combination against each monotherapy[387](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=387)[388](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=388) . The combination lowered PVR by 29% vs macitentan and 28% vs tadalafil[569](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=569) . An FDA meeting record states that PVR was accepted as a basis for substantial evidence that each component contributed to the effect, with the sponsor relying on prior FDA findings for tadalafil[570](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=570)[571](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=571) .
2. **Pediatric extrapolation.** For pediatric sildenafil, FDA accepted change in PVRI across ages 1 to 17 because younger children cannot reliably perform exercise testing. The advisory committee considered this suitable for a drug already approved in adult PAH[676](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=676) . The primary peak VO2 endpoint narrowly missed (p=0.056), while combined-dose PVRI improved by -4.1 Wood units·m² (p=0.041)[678](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=678)[679](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=679) . The bridge relied on FDA analyses of adult data linking drug-induced PVRI or mPAP changes with 6MWD changes[680](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=680)[681](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=681) . Even so, a statistical reviewer called PVRI a poor surrogate for adult 6MWD at the individual level[309](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=309) . A 2012 review recommended against pediatric approval because of a dose-related mortality signal in the long-term extension[682](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=682)[683](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=683) . FDA later approved a pediatric indication in January 2023 (ages 1 to 17), worded as improving exercise ability and, in children too young for standardized exercise testing, pulmonary hemodynamics thought to underlie improvements in exercise[678](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=678) .


### Mortality: an endpoint component, not a demonstrated claim


None of the PAH programs reviewed here established a standalone survival benefit in a controlled trial:


- Ambrisentan: deaths numerically favored the drug but not significantly. Reviewers dismissed comparisons with a historical NIH registry[475](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=475) .
- Macitentan: no apparent effect on overall mortality, and PAH death alone was not significant[94](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=94) .
- Selexipag: all-cause mortality HR 0.97[515](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=515) .
- Sotatercept: deaths were 7 vs 13 in ZENITH and 7 vs 6 in HYPERION. The labeling presents mortality as component or secondary information rather than a separately tested claim[558](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=558)[559](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=559)[564](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=564) .
- Bosentan: the label stated that long-term uncontrolled follow-up could not determine the effect on mortality[367](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=367) .


### Implications for PAH development programs


- **Match the endpoint to the claim.** A positive 12- to 16-week 6MWD trial has repeatedly supported an exercise-capacity indication[215](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=215)[469](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=469) . Delaying disease progression or reducing hospitalization has required an adequately powered, event-driven primary endpoint[511](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=511)[512](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=512) .
- **Pre-specify the hierarchy and protect alpha.** Statistical reviewers have discounted secondary clinical-worsening results when the analysis plan changed late or multiplicity was not controlled[474](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=474)[277](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=277) .
- **Expect scrutiny of effect size, timing and blinding of 6MWD.** Peak vs trough measurement[429](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=429) , within-arm deterioration[517](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=517) and open-label conduct[275](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=275) have all affected how reviewers read walk-distance results.
- **Use hemodynamics as mechanistic support.** PVR can carry a fixed-dose combination's contribution-of-components argument[570](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=570) or a pediatric extrapolation[676](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=676) , but it has not substituted for clinical efficacy in a new adult PAH entity.
- **Design composites with adjudicated, multi-criterion progression events.** FDA reviewers have looked through the composite to its drivers (hospitalization and progression rather than death)[207](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=207)[93](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=93) , and labeling has reflected that[95](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=95)[564](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/fda-endpoints-in-pulmonary-arterial-hypertension?showSourceNumber=564) .
